lead: 30 days with the full system under your own practice name, and no sales calls. This is the complete list of conditions.
note: Trial practices get the same support as paying customers. If 30 days is not enough, for example because a colleague is on holiday, ask us; we usually say yes.

terms.title: How long
terms.text: Counted from the day the practice account is created, not from the first sign-in.

terms.title: Payment details
terms.text: No card, bank details or mandate, so there is nothing to cancel.

terms.title: What is limited
terms.text: Everything else is the full Praxis plan, including insurance billing and reminders.

terms.title: SMS during the trial
terms.text: Enough to test reminders. After 50, no more SMS are sent.

terms.title: Real patient data
terms.text: A data-processing agreement is issued automatically before you can enter any data.

terms.title: On the last day
terms.text: The practice becomes read-only. Nothing is charged and no subscription starts by itself.

terms.title: If you continue
terms.text: Choose a plan, and all appointments, documents and settings from the trial carry over.

terms.title: If you stop
terms.text: The export stays available for 60 days. Then we delete the practice and confirm it in writing.
